visual: Sunrise over a colorful jungle, birds flying
narration: Deep in the jungle, where the tallest trees touch the clouds, lived a little monkey named Milo.

visual: Milo the monkey swinging between branches, smiling
narration: Milo loved to swing from branch to branch. Whee! But today, something was different.

visual: Milo stops, looks at a shiny blue egg in a nest
narration: Right there, in a cozy nest, sat a shiny blue egg. "Whose egg is this?" Milo wondered.

visual: Milo carries the egg carefully, walking past a river with a friendly hippo
narration: Milo decided to find the egg's family. First, he asked Hanna the hippo. "Is this your egg?" "No, little monkey, my babies don't come from eggs!"

visual: A big friendly toucan lands next to Milo, wings open wide
narration: Just then, Tula the toucan swooped down. "My egg! You found my egg! Thank you, Milo!"

visual: The egg hatches, a tiny toucan chick appears, everyone cheers
narration: Crack, crack, crack! Out came a tiny chick. And from that day on, Milo had a brand new friend.
